ticker_news.title: Take Control of Your Cash Flow; Energy Stocks on Fire
ticker_news.description: The Motley Fool's 2026 Financial Planning Challenge focuses on intentional cash flow management. Energy stocks lead market performance, up 18% in 2026 and outperforming tech over five years. The episode covers four steps for financial planning: tracking spending, choosing debt strategies, building emergency savings, and automating finances. Bond market performance remains weak due to historically low starting yields five years ago.
ticker_news.author: Motley Fool Staff
